newsitem.title: USA: VSI Holdings sees EPS $0.09 for rest of year.
newsitem.headline: VSI Holdings sees EPS $0.09 for rest of year.

text.p: VSI Holdings Inc said Friday it estimates sufficient revenues and earnings to generate $0.09 per share on the 12,098,087 shares outstanding for the the remainder of 1997.
The company reported a loss per share for the quarter ended March 31 of $0.02 compared to a loss of $0.08 per share for the same period a year ago.
It reported a net loss of $202,000 compared to a loss of $930,000 , and net sales of $5.3 million compared to net sales of $5.2 million.
